commits.author: ec-
commits.message: Add \g_predictPVS - try to predict PVS to avoid "sudden" enemy and items spawns causes by client lag (i.e. delayed PVS checks on server-side)  for example, this can be observed on q3dm11 when moving from Slime Halls to Arch Room
